```{r}
#| label: setup
#| output: false
#| message: false
#| warning: false
# Load the project's functions from the checkout (decision 0042) and read the
# published data bundle, so this code reproduces the figure (decision 0040).
root <- Sys.getenv("CFB2NFL_ROOT")
if (!nzchar(root)) root <- pkgload::pkg_path()
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = root)
pkgload::load_all(root, quiet = TRUE)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggiraph)

con <- DBI::dbConnect(
  duckdb::duckdb(),
  file.path(root, "data", "cfb2nfl.duckdb"),
  read_only = TRUE
)
release <- data_release_date()
first_record <- 2010L
first_season <- 2013L
last_season <- 2025L # the 2026 season is still being played
# The two five-year windows compared; 2018 falls between them and is left out.
early <- c(2013L, 2017L)
late <- c(2019L, 2023L)
fbs_seasons <- tbl(con, "team_season") |>
  filter(
    classification == "fbs",
    season >= first_record,
    season <= last_season
  ) |>
  collect()
credited <- tbl(con, "team_draft") |>
  filter(
    season >= first_season,
    season <= last_season,
    tier_label != "FCS and below"
  ) |>
  collect()
teams <- tbl(con, "teams") |> collect()
DBI::dbDisconnect(con, shutdown = TRUE)
```

```{r}
#| label: compute
#| output: false
school <- school_record(fbs_seasons, credited)
tier_levels <- levels(school$tier)
# A school's draft rate and win % within one window of seasons.
rate_in <- function(w) {
  credited |>
    filter(season >= w[1], season <= w[2]) |>
    group_by(team) |>
    summarise(
      eligible = sum(n_eligible),
      rate = sum(n_drafted) / sum(n_eligible),
      .groups = "drop"
    )
}
win_in <- function(w) {
  fbs_seasons |>
    filter(season >= w[1], season <= w[2]) |>
    group_by(team) |>
    summarise(win = sum(wins) / sum(wins + losses), .groups = "drop")
}
# Schools with eligible players in both windows, with their two rates each.
wide <- school |>
  select(team, tier) |>
  inner_join(
    rate_in(early) |> rename(elig_early = eligible, rate_early = rate),
    by = "team"
  ) |>
  inner_join(
    rate_in(late) |> rename(elig_late = eligible, rate_late = rate),
    by = "team"
  ) |>
  inner_join(win_in(early) |> rename(win_early = win), by = "team") |>
  inner_join(win_in(late) |> rename(win_late = win), by = "team") |>
  filter(elig_early > 0, elig_late > 0)
# Correlation between windows for each tier, with its plausible range.
cor_window <- function(d, x, y) {
  ct <- cor.test(d[[x]], d[[y]])
  tibble::tibble(
    r = unname(ct$estimate),
    lo = ct$conf.int[1],
    hi = ct$conf.int[2]
  )
}
rate_cor <- wide |>
  group_by(tier) |>
  group_modify(\(g, k) {
    bind_cols(
      tibble::tibble(schools = nrow(g)),
      cor_window(g, "rate_early", "rate_late") |>
        rename(r_rate = r, lo_rate = lo, hi_rate = hi),
      cor_window(g, "win_early", "win_late") |>
        rename(r_win = r, lo_win = lo, hi_win = hi)
    )
  }) |>
  ungroup()
# The schools that moved most within the Power tier, labelled on the figure.
movers <- wide |>
  filter(tier == "Power") |>
  mutate(move = abs(rate_late - rate_early)) |>
  slice_max(move, n = 3)
wide$tip <- paste0(
  wide$team,
  " (",
  wide$tier,
  ")\nDraft rate in the early window: ",
  sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * wide$rate_early),
  "\nDraft rate in the later window: ",
  sprintf("%.1f%%", 100 * wide$rate_late)
)
long <- wide |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    c(rate_early, rate_late),
    names_to = "window",
    values_to = "rate"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    window = factor(
      if_else(window == "rate_early", "Early window", "Later window"),
      levels = c("Early window", "Later window")
    )
  )
```

```{r}
#| label: figure
p <- ggplot(wide, aes(rate_early, rate_late, color = tier)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", color = "#6b7280") +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    size = 3.4,
    alpha = 0.6
  ) +
  geom_text(
    data = movers,
    aes(label = team),
    color = "#111827",
    hjust = 0,
    nudge_x = 0.01,
    nudge_y = 0.02,
    size = 4.5,
    fontface = "bold",
    check_overlap = TRUE,
    show.legend = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = tier_palette()[tier_levels], name = NULL) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = "Draft rate, early window",
    y = "Draft rate, later window",
    title = "Power schools keep their place in the draft rate from one window to the next",
    subtitle = "Each dot is a school; dots on the dashed line did not change",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_card()

card_thumbnail(p, "draft-rate-across-windows", release = release)
card_interactive(p, width_svg = 11, height_svg = 6.5)
```

```{r}
#| label: explore
p_explore <- ggplot(long, aes(window, rate, group = team)) +
  geom_line(color = "#9ca3af", linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point_interactive(
    aes(fill = team, tooltip = tip, data_id = team),
    shape = 21,
    size = 4,
    color = "white",
    stroke = 0.6
  ) +
  facet_wrap(~tier, scales = "free_y") +
  scale_fill_team(teams, guide = "none") +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::percent) +
  labs(
    x = NULL,
    y = "Draft rate",
    title = "Every school's draft rate in the two windows",
    subtitle = "Team colors; a line that slopes up gained draftees, one that slopes down lost them; hover a dot for the rates",
    caption = card_caption(release)
  ) +
  theme_cfb2nfl()
card_interactive(p_explore, width_svg = 13, height_svg = 8)
```

```{r}
#| label: table
rate_cor |>
  transmute(
    Tier = tier,
    Schools = schools,
    `r, draft rate` = sprintf("%.2f", r_rate),
    `Plausible range, draft rate` = paste(sprintf("%.2f", lo_rate), "to", sprintf("%.2f", hi_rate)),
    `r, win %` = sprintf("%.2f", r_win),
    `Plausible range, win %` = paste(sprintf("%.2f", lo_win), "to", sprintf("%.2f", hi_win))
  ) |>
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c(
      "Tier", "Schools", "r, draft rate", "Plausible range, draft rate",
      "r, win %", "Plausible range, win %"
    ),
    caption = "Correlation between each school's early and later window, by tier, for its draft rate and its win %. Schools need eligible players in both windows (2013 to 2017 and 2019 to 2023; 2018 is left out). The plausible range is the span the true correlation likely falls in (a 95% confidence interval)."
  )
```
